integrity: The all-length upper bound and witness family follow from elementary finite local-change identities. Direct small-length enumeration and the sixty-four-case boundary calculation were replayed from the embedded programs; these tests are not independent scientific certification.
limitations: Binary linear words and exactly two symbol deletions; overlapping length-two count vectors only. The motivating September 2026 preprint was available only through abstract evidence; an exact historical-priority comparison of its full text remains unfinished. This result does not imply improved coding rates or generalize to longer profiles.
title: Sharp two-deletion dinucleotide-profile capacity and its limiting boundary law
